agent: occupation and revolt wave, reader C (rebels made)
question: How rebel brigades are made: CreateRebelsForFaction (rva 0xBAA20) whole, CreateRebelBrigadesInProvince (0xC1160) with 0xB9150, the faction made when none matches (0x286D80), an independence type's country (0xBF6F0), FindRebelFactionForProvince (0x286CF0), and the two script effects.

addresses.name: CreateRebelsForFaction
addresses.signature: int* __fastcall CreateRebelsForFaction(CCountryTag* actor@ECX, CRebelFaction* faction@stack:4, int* outArmyId@stack:8, CMapProvince* province@stack:0xC, int count@stack:0x10, bool forActor@stack:0x14) @EAX
addresses.comment:
**Makes one rebel army of one to four brigades in a province, for a faction.** 0x4BAA20 to the second `ret 0x14` at 0x4BBA80 (the first is the count == 0 exit at 0x4BAA63) - 0x1063 bytes, not the 0xDE0 this entry used to say. Three callers: SpawnFullRevoltInProvince (0x4A6D38), CreateRebelBrigadesInProvince (0x4C134A) and CreateRebelFaction (0x686EE7). Read whole on the listing, 2026-10-14:

    if (count == 0) { *out = {0,0}; return out }                       ; before the clamp
    owner = faction->units_owner (+0x4C, always REB)
    if (forActor) owner = *actor
    elif (faction->type->auto_convert (+0x19B)
          && CountryOf(province->owner)->government_in_exile (+0x95)
          && province->owner_id != province->controller_id) owner = province->owner
    count = clamp(count, 1, 4)
    army = new CArmy (0x308), id {0x27, g_rebel_id++}, named RebelFaction_MakeArmyName (0x4BBE20)
    CCountry::AddUnit(owner, army); CUnit_SetOwner(army, owner)
    append {0x27, id} to faction->armies (+0x80/+0x84/+0x88)
    repeat count times:
        b = new CSubUnit (0xD8) with CRegiment's vftable, id {0x27, g_rebel_id++}
        name = CCountry::MakeSubUnitName(faction->country (+0x38), definition, province, faction)
        CSubUnit::SetType(b, faction->type->unit (+0x188)); b->home (+0x64) = province
        t = faction->targets_first (+0x70)                                ; the FIRST target
        b->experience (+0x3C) += CountryOf(t)->values[PARTISAN_EFFICENCY] (+0x278), capped 100000
        for each technology of the definition: level = L ? Random() % L : 0, L = t's level
        CSubUnit::ApplyTechnologies(b, false)        ; strength and organisation to the new maxima
        AddRegimentToUnit(army, b)
    CUnit::EnterProvince(army, province); avatar_stale = 1; CUnit::RebuildAvatar; EnterProvince again
    intel_level (+0x1F8) for the player, inlined: 9 for his own, his faction's or an ally's, else the province's figure
    CCombatManager::CheckForCombat(army, province)
    message (below); *out = army id; return out

The inlined MT19937 draw at 0x4BADED is the technology level, one draw per technology the target has at a level above 0. Experience starts at the CSubUnit constructor's -1000 and nothing else in the path writes it, so a brigade begins at -1000 + the target's partisan_efficiency. No leader is given: the complete call list has no leader call. Nothing writes the faction's provinces (+0x94).

**The message.** The province's controller is captured before the battle check. Where the controller is the player: type `REVOLT`, the controller's BuildMessageVariables plus MESSENGER (MESSAGE_HEAD_MARS rendered), REBELS (the faction's name, +0x54), REBELDESC (RebelFaction_GetDescText) and PROV (the province's name), an empty head, both country pairs the faction's +0x4C (REB) - then the sound `army_selected` played unless it is already playing. Otherwise, where the army's owner is the player: type `PARTISANS`, the owner's variables plus MESSENGER, PROV and EVIL (the controller's name), both country pairs the owner. Nobody else is told. Signature corrected 2026-10-02 by the signature audit (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-sigaudit.md); body, extent and parameter names 2026-10-14.
addresses.evidence: Every instruction from 0x4BAA20 to 0x4BBA83 decoded in one resumed pass (1276 instructions, a scratch listing.py), with the complete direct-call list: CArmy ctor 0x4828C0, CSubUnit ctor 0x5A88F0, SetType, ApplyTechnologies (push ebx=0 as keepStrength at 0x4BAE65), AddRegimentToUnit, EnterProvince twice, RebuildAvatar, CheckForCombat, MakeSubUnitName, BuildMessageVariables twice, CMessage ctor twice; no SetLeader, no RebelFaction_TakeProvince, no write to +0x94/+0x98. The owner choice is 0x4BAA66..0x4BAAC4, the clamp 0x4BAAC7..0x4BAADD, PARTISAN_EFFICENCY 0x4BAD1A..0x4BAD51 off [faction+0x70], the draw 0x4BADBE..0x4BAE49 with `idiv [ebp-0x74]` (the target's level), the message choice 0x4BB042 (controller id vs CCurrentGameState +0xC34) and 0x4BB6D1 (owner id). The -1000 start is the CSubUnit constructor's store at 0x5A8A18, and SetType, ApplyTechnologies, AddRegimentToUnit and 0x5A8BB0 hold no +0x3C store (positive control: the same scan finds ApplyTechnologies' +0x5C/+0x60 clamps). Would be shown wrong by a write of experience on another path between creation and the first read, or by +0x70's first node not being the province controller at creation.

addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x4C1160..0x4C142F end to end: the forActor walk 0x4C123B..0x4C126E (cmp [eax+0x30], rebelType; cmp [eax+0x3C], [actor+4]), the SetProvinceRevoltRisk call at 0x4C1301 with its three pushes (ebx, a slot written ebx, edi) ahead of `cmp esi, ebx` at 0x4C1306, the REB test 0x4C130A..0x4C1323 and the RebelFaction_AddTarget call at 0x4C1333 with esi = faction, and the CreateRebelFaction call at 0x4C1416 (ecx = rebelType, edi = province, pushes: actor, forActor, a 0x1C string assigned from 0x15B4945 whose first byte is 0, count, game state). addresses.name: FindRebelFactionForProvince
addresses.signature: CRebelFaction* __fastcall FindRebelFactionForProvince(CCurrentGameState* state@EAX, CMapProvince* province@stack:4, CRebelType* rebelType@stack:8) @EAX
addresses.comment:
**Which existing faction a new rising of this rebel type in this province joins.** 0x686CF0 to the two `ret 8`; game state in eax. Over the factions at CCurrentGameState +0xC7C, only those whose type (+0x30) is rebelType:

    if (rebelType->independence (+0x190))            ; 0 or 1
        if (faction->independence.id (+0x48) == ChooseRebelIndependenceTag(rebelType, province).id)
            return faction                           ; the first match
    elif (rebelType->area (+0x180) == 0              ; `area = nation`
          && faction->country.id (+0x3C) == province->owner_id (+0x330))
        found = faction                              ; kept, and the walk goes on
    return found                                     ; the last match, or null

So an independence type has **one faction per country it would free**, a nation-wide type **one faction per country it rises in** (the province's owner, and the last in the list wins), and a type whose `area` is anything but `nation` **never matches** - every rising of it makes a new faction. Corrected 2026-10-14: this entry said one faction per (rebel type, area), which is not what the comparisons do. Signature corrected 2026-10-02 by the signature audit (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-sigaudit.md).
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x686CF0..0x686D7C whole: `cmp [esi+0x30], eax` then `cmp [eax+0x190], 0` (0x686D1D); the independence arm pushes province, &tmp, type to 0x4BF6F0 and compares ebx = [esi+0x48] with [eax+4], returning at 0x686D4A; the other arm tests [eax+0x180] == 0 and [esi+0x3C] == [province+0x330] and stores [ebp-4] = esi without leaving the loop (0x686D6A), returned at 0x686D71. The values of +0x180 and +0x190 are the loader's: area = (token != 0x649 `nation`) at 0x4BFB95, independence = (token != 0x18D `none`) at 0x4BFBE7. Wrong if a faction's +0x3C were not the country it rose in, which CRebelFaction::CRebelFaction sets at 0x4B9062.

addresses.name: RebelFaction_AddTarget
addresses.signature: void __stdcall RebelFaction_AddTarget(CRebelFaction* faction@ESI, char tag[4]@stack:4, int id@stack:8)
addresses.comment: **A country the faction fights.** Appends {tag, id} to the faction's targets (+0x70 first, +0x74 last, +0x78 count; 0x14-byte nodes, next at +0xC) unless a node with the same id is already there. 0x4B9150 to the `ret 8`s at 0x4B91AF and 0x4B91B7; the faction in ESI. One caller, CreateRebelBrigadesInProvince (0x4C1333), with the province's controller whenever it is not REB - so every province a faction rises in adds its controller. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled whole (0x4B9150..0x4B91B7): the duplicate walk compares [node+4] with the id argument, the new node gets [ebp+8], [ebp+0xC], the old tail, 0, 0, and the head/tail/count stores are +0x70/+0x74/+0x78. findRefs --callers gives the one call at 0x4C1333, where ESI holds the faction and the pushes are [province+0x338], [province+0x334]. Wrong if +0x70 were a different list from the one the faction's `target=` lines are saved from (BiceLib's header names it from SaveContents).

addresses.name: CreateRebelFaction
addresses.no_signature: Two register arguments and a 0x1C-byte std::string by value: rebelType in ECX, province in EDI; on the stack the game state (+4), count (+8), the string (+0xC..+0x27), forActor (+0x28) and the actor's CCountryTag* (+0x2C); `ret 0x2C`; the new CRebelFaction* (or null) in EAX.
addresses.comment:
**A rebel faction made where none matches, and its first army.** 0x686D80 to the two `ret 0x2C`. Two callers: CreateRebelBrigadesInProvince (0x4C1416) and SpawnFullRevoltInProvince (0x4A6DF4).

    if (rebelType && rebelType->independence && !forActor
        && ChooseRebelIndependenceTag(rebelType, province).id == 0)
        rebelType = ChooseRebelTypeForProvince(db, province, false, "---")   ; chosen again
    if (!province || !rebelType) return null
    f = new CRebelFaction (0xA4 bytes) - CRebelFaction::CRebelFaction(rebelType, province, name,
            forActor, actor, province->controller tag, id)
    f->id = {0x27, g_rebel_id++}                       ; slot 6
    append f to CCurrentGameState +0xC7C/+0xC80/+0xC84 (0x10-byte nodes, next at +8)
    CreateRebelsForFaction(actor, f, &tmp, province, count, forActor)
    return f

The re-chosen type is not tested again, and the name argument is passed on but never read. The name is ours.

addresses.name: ChooseRebelIndependenceTag
addresses.signature: CCountryTag* __stdcall ChooseRebelIndependenceTag(CRebelType* rebelType, CCountryTag* out, CMapProvince* province)
addresses.comment: **The country an independence-seeking rising in this province would free** - a country tag, not an area. `---`/0 when the province is null or in no real area or the type's independence (+0x190) is 0. Otherwise candidates, in order: each core of the province (+0x344) that is not REB, owns no province (owned_province_count +0xCF8 <= 0) and is not already listed; then each country of the database that is not REB, owns no province, is not listed, and whose original capital (CCountry::GetOriginalCapital) is this province or a neighbour of it (CProvinceTemplate::HasEdgeTo). Each scores 1000 when independence == 1 (it can only be 0 or 1), **+200000 when the province is its core**, **+300000 when its original capital is this province**; the first strictly highest wins. 0x4BF6F0 to the `ret 0xC`s at 0x4BF73B and 0x4BFA33. Four callers: CRebelFaction::CRebelFaction, ChooseRebelTypeForProvince, FindRebelFactionForProvince, CreateRebelFaction. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x4BF6F0..0x4BFA33 whole: the early `---` exit 0x4BF717, the core walk 0x4BF768..0x4BF80D (REB bytes, [country+0xCF8] > 0 skip, duplicate id walk, node append), the country walk 0x4BF817..0x4BF92E (database +0x168 count, +0x16C array, GetOriginalCapital 0x4DDB30 compared with [province+0xD0], else HasEdgeTo 0x4A9C40 with EDI = [province+0xD4]), the scoring 0x4BF955..0x4BFA05 (history `capital` token 0x1F9 else +0xE20; 0x3E8 when [type+0x190] == 1; +0x30D40 on a core id match; +0x493E0 on capital == [province+0xD0]; `cmp ecx, [ebp-0x14]; jle`). Wrong if the +0x344 list were not the province's cores, which the record names from the save writer.

addresses.name: RebelFaction_ChooseGovernment
addresses.comment: **The government a new rebel faction would install** (+0x40). Starts from its country's government, or the independence country's where that one is not valid_for_new_country (+0x64); then over every government in the database (the vector at [0x1A87864]+0xC) whose slot 17 answers true (a real government, not CNullGovernment) and which is valid_for_new_country: 1000, or **31000 when its ideologies list holds the rebel type's ideology** (+0x184), **+50000 when it is the faction country's present government**; the first strictly highest replaces +0x40. Where the result is null or not real, the province owner's government; where that fails too, a log line from rebelfaction.cpp: "Rebel Faction type '...' in <country> could not find a valid Government type." One caller, the constructor (0x4B90DA). `ret 4`. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x4BC900..0x4BCA27 and the decompiler for the fallback: [country+0xDFC] into +0x40 at 0x4BC932, the +0x64 test, the vector walk at 0x4BC98C, slot 0x44 call then `cmp byte [esi+0x64], 0`, edi = 0x3E8 / 0x7918 on an ideology node equal to [type+0x184], `add edi, 0xC350` when [country+0xDFC] == esi, `cmp edi, [ebp+8]; jle`. CGovernment slot 17 is `mov al, 1` (0xA92590) and CNullGovernment's `xor al, al` (0x592360). The fallback and its log text are read off the decompiler only; wrong if the ideology `any` resolved to a non-null CIdeology, which was not checked.

addresses.name: CRebelFaction::RenderText

addresses.comment: **A faction's localised text**: GetText(key) with COUNTRY = the adjective of the faction's country (+0x38), INDEP = the adjective of its independence country (+0x44) where that has an id, and EVIL = the adjective of its first target (+0x70) where there is one with an id; rendered into out. addresses.name: RebelFaction_MakeArmyName
addresses.comment: **A new rebel army's name**: for n = 1, 2, ..., itoa(n) + the localised ordinal (`TH` for n % 10 in 0 and 4..9, `ST` 1, `ND` 2, `RD` 3, and `TH` whenever n - 11 is 0..2) + " " + RebelFaction_GetArmyText(faction); the first that RebelFaction_IsArmyNameTaken does not report is written to out. struct_fields.name: units_owner
struct_fields.comment: **Who owns the armies the faction raises, unless the call says otherwise: always REB.** Both constructors write CCountryDataBase::GetTag("REB") here (0x4B8E93 for the loader's, 0x4B8FEC for a new faction's) and nothing else writes it; it is not saved. CreateRebelsForFaction takes the owner from here when it is not raising for an actor or converting to a government in exile, and passes this pair as both country pairs of the REVOLT message. Tag here, id at +0x50.
struct_fields.evidence: The two GetTag("REB") stores into [esi+0x4C] at 0x4B8E98 and 0x4B8FF1 (0x15BE948 is 'REB'); the reads at 0x4BAA66/0x4BAA69 and 0x4BB59C/0x4BB59F. Not among the ten keys CRebelFaction::LoadKey switches on. Wrong if a third writer existed; findRefs on the REB literal lists eleven sites, and only these two are in rebel-faction code.

struct_fields.name: government
struct_fields.comment: the government they would install, saved as `government`. **Read live**: a CGovernment by its own RTTI; the mod defines eighteen. **Chosen once, when the faction is made**, by RebelFaction_ChooseGovernment (rva 0xBC900): among real, valid_for_new_country governments, 31000 for one whose ideologies hold the rebel type's ideology, else 1000, +50000 for the faction country's own present government; the first highest.
struct_fields.evidence: Type changed from void* to CGovernment*: the live read already found a CGovernment, and 0x4BC900 stores [country+0xDFC] (CCountry::Government) and database entries whose +0x64 is CGovernment's valid_for_new_country. Name unchanged.

struct_fields.name: targets_first
struct_fields.comment: **who they are fighting**, a CCountryTag per entry and one `target=` line each; nodes of 20 bytes - the tag's four characters, its id, the previous node, the next and a spare. **The first is the controller of the province the faction was made in** (CRebelFaction::CRebelFaction), and each later rising adds that province's controller unless it is REB or already there (RebelFaction_AddTarget, rva 0xB9150). **The first target's country is what CreateRebelsForFaction equips new brigades from**: its partisan_efficiency goes on their experience and each technology's level is drawn below its level.
struct_fields.evidence: Comment only; name and type unchanged. The constructor's target append at 0x4B907C..0x4B90BD from the controller arguments, RebelFaction_AddTarget's call at 0x4C1333, and CreateRebelsForFaction's reads of [[faction+0x70]] and [[faction+0x70]+4] at 0x4BAD1A..0x4BAD2E.

struct_fields.name: area
struct_fields.comment: the `area` key (token 0x648) - how far the rebels roam. **0 for `nation` and 1 for any other value**: the loader stores (token != 0x649 `nation`). A nation-wide type keeps one faction per country it rises in (FindRebelFactionForProvince, rva 0x286CF0); a type with any other area never matches an existing faction. The daily faction pass treats 0 as the value that lets a faction die when its country holds nothing.
struct_fields.evidence: Comment only. CRebelType::LoadKey's case at 0x4BFB90: `cmp [ctx+0x228], 0x649; setne al; mov [edi+0x180], eax`; saveTokens.json gives 0x649 = `nation`. The case-to-key pairing is the one the record already has for this offset.

struct_fields.name: defection
struct_fields.comment: the `defection` key (token 0x64F). **0 for `none` and 1 for any other value**: the loader stores (token != 0x18D `none`).
struct_fields.evidence: Comment only. CRebelType::LoadKey at 0x4BFBB9: `cmp [ctx+0x228], 0x18D; setne al; mov [edi+0x18C], eax`; 0x18D = `none` in saveTokens.json.

struct_fields.name: independence
struct_fields.comment: the `independence` key (token 0x651). **0 for `none` and 1 for any other value** (`any` in the files): the loader stores (token != 0x18D `none`). Non-zero makes FindRebelFactionForProvince (rva 0x286CF0) match a faction by the country ChooseRebelIndependenceTag (rva 0xBF6F0) picks for the province, so there is one faction per country to be freed; that chooser gives a candidate its base 1000 only when this is exactly 1.
struct_fields.evidence: Comment corrected: it said the faction's own *area* had to match; it is the independence country's id ([faction+0x48] against 0x4BF6F0's answer at 0x686D3D). Loader case at 0x4BFBE2: `cmp [ctx+0x228], 0x18D; setne al; mov [edi+0x190], eax`.
